verdict: approved bounded saved-journal source repair and API
sourceChecks: Read diff and complete journal/transaction-outcome interactions before packet. Only two paths changed; existing no-argument APIs preserved.

Every actual recovery resend now authenticates the original ciphertext even for first attempt; context guard after final storage/decryption await closes prior last-read lock gap. Exclusive caller account lease remains essential.

Options capture own data exact operation/hash and optional trusted callback before storage awaits; wrong/hash/op/accessor/extra fields fail before node queries. Callback is captured once and receives exact current hash.

inspectSavedRecovery returns detached frozen status only and never writes/acknowledges/authorizes. Dropped+valid requires second matching dropped receipt; intervening pending/canonical state is not resend authority. Timeout active flag suppresses later follow-up reads.

Both recover and reconcilePrevious share the exact-bound send path. Persisted missing-anchor predecessor policy remains required; caller cannot downgrade it via recovery options. Unknown/canonical/live predecessors refuse resend.

Second receipt after validation prevents duplicate broadcast when reinclusion is observed; canonical current receipt remains read-only reconciliation. Exact transaction bytes/hash are reused without proof or fee generation.

Original134 SDK-Tx/AEAD synthetic-chain cases retained; focused first-attempt CAS/late lock, strict predecessors, exact inspection/binding, callback mutation/failure, reinclusion and timeout regressions independently exercised.
